How do I handle the 'send me an email' objection?
How do I handle the 'send me an email' objection?
answer: When a prospect says 'send me an email,' use the Acknowledge — Reframe — Redirect (ARR) pattern [2]. First, Acknowledge the request so the prospect feels heard [2]. Then Reframe by asking one qualifying question to find out what they actually care about — this helps you write a relevant email instead of a generic one [2]. Finally, Redirect by confirming you'll follow up and use that moment to book a specific time to connect [2]. This keeps the conversation alive rather than letting it die in their inbox. Avoid jumping straight into a scripted rebuttal — that reads as defensive and skips the real concern underneath [1]. The goal is a short, natural exchange: 'Absolutely, happy to send something over — quick question so I make it useful: what's your biggest priority around [topic] right now?' Then lock in a follow-up time before you hang up [2].
